players.product: Advantage2 annealing quantum computers and dual-rail superconducting gate-model systems (Quantum Circuits)

quarterly_data.signal: D-Wave 8-K: on September 4, 2026 D-Wave entered an Other Transaction Agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce under the CHIPS and Science Act for an award of up to $100,000,000 to fund R&D on prototyping semiconductor technology for quantum and scalable quantum components for annealing and gate-model superconducting quantum computers - an initial tranche of $53,552,620 shortly after the award date, then $9,075,000, $16,695,000 and $20,390,000 on milestones (tool and equipment installation, QPU prototype fabrication, process integration, calibration and benchmarking of scaled QPUs) and $287,380 at completion, over up to five years. D-Wave says the funding supports its next-generation systems, including a 100,000-qubit annealing system and a 10,000-qubit gate-model system designed for 100 logical qubits performing more than one million operations. The Department of Commerce receives a minority, non-controlling equity stake in D-Wave as a condition of the funds.
